create_VLChatProcessor: create a VLChatProcessor with a VLMImageProcessor and LlamaTokenizerFast for multimodal chat inference
build_VLMImageProcessor: build a VLMImageProcessor that resizes, pads, and normalizes PIL images for vision-language model input
configure_MultiModalityConfig: configure a MultiModalityConfig with vision, aligner, generation vision, and language model configurations
batchify_VLChatProcessor: batchify a list of VLChatProcessorOutput instances into padded tensors with attention and image masks
process_one_VLChatProcessor: process one prompt and image pair through the VLChatProcessor to get tokenized input_ids and pixel_values
